overall_comment: The patient presents with a large, solitary left-sided glioma with extensive involvement of the insula and deep gray matter. The MRI features of a large necrotic and enhancing core, extensive surrounding edema, and significant mass effect are all classic radiological hallmarks of a high-grade glioma. The combination of these features with the patient's age (51) makes Glioblastoma, IDH-wildtype, CNS WHO grade 4 the most probable diagnosis with very high confidence. The predictions for IDH status, 1p/19q status, and WHO grade are internally consistent with this diagnosis.
